usageNotes: Use this to read the firewall configuration for a specific LXC container on a PDM-managed PVE remote, including whether the firewall is enabled, default inbound/outbound policies, and protocol-level options like DHCP, NDP, IP filtering, and MAC filtering. Requires the Resource.Audit privilege on the remote/guest path. The optional 'node' query param is only needed when PDM cannot infer the node automatically from the VMID.

examples.summary: Fetch firewall options for LXC 201 on remote 'pve-hetzner'

tips: All returned fields are optional; missing fields indicate the cluster/host default applies (e.g., macfilter defaults to true, enable defaults to false).
If 'enable' is false, any firewall rules on the container are defined but inactive — check this field first when debugging unexpected traffic behavior.
ipfilter being enabled adds implicit IP restrictions per interface; combined with policy_in DROP this is a strong deny-by-default posture for containers.
log_level_in and log_level_out default to 'nolog'; set to 'info' or 'debug' on PVE directly to capture iptables hits without modifying the policy.
